title: Regime-conditional robust vol models (VIX-tertile rolling ex-ante, K1136/K1138 extension)
description: Test whether robust volatility models (HAR-RV-X, GARCH-MIDAS-X, GAS-t) have conditional (regime-specific) PASS against GJR-GARCH baseline, using rolling 252-day ex-ante VIX tertile regimes (avoiding K1128 IS-fixed degeneracy). 6 assets × 3 models × 3 regimes = 54 cells with BH-FDR correction.

robust_models.M3_GARCH_MIDAS_X: τ_t = exp(m + θ × VIX²_monthly_lag1); g_t GJR. r²-native.
robust_models.M4_HAR_RV_X: Corsi 2009 HAR on log-Parkinson + log(VIX²_{t-1}). Parkinson-native. Vs M1 uses M1 GJR forecast on Parkinson target.

leakage_safeguards: VIX lagged by 1 day before regime assignment
Quantile computed on VIX[t-252 .. t-1] (strictly past)

evaluation.underpowered_skip: regime bar count < 30 → skip DM, force p=1

hypotheses.A_conditional_pass: Some (asset, model, regime) triple PASSES → Paper 4 regime subsection
hypotheses.C_har_regime_invariant: HAR+VIX PASSES all 3 regimes on ≥2 equity assets
hypotheses.D_gas_regime_rescue: GAS-t HARMFUL pooled but PASS/TIED on some regime

summary.verdict_note: HAR+VIX PASSES across all 3 regimes for ≥2 equity assets AND ≥8 total PASS cells. Paper 4 Channel 1 can claim regime-invariant robustness for HAR+VIX on equity.

references: Engle, Ghysels, Sohn (2013) Review of Economics and Statistics 95(3):776-797.
Creal, Koopman, Lucas (2013) J Applied Econometrics 28(5):777-795.
Harvey, Leybourne, Newbold (1997) Int J Forecasting 13:281-291.
Benjamini, Hochberg (1995) J Royal Statistical Society B 57(1):289-300.

notes.K1128_lesson: K1137 uses ROLLING 252-day ex-ante VIX percentile, not IS-fixed quantile, to avoid the OOS-coverage-degeneracy observed in K1128/K1130/K1131.
notes.M4_vs_M1_convention: M4 HAR-RV-X evaluated on Parkinson-native; M1 GJR-N forecasts r² natively but is scored on Parkinson here for a direct robust-vs-baseline test (not within-HAR-family).
